{
  "labels": [
    {"i": 0, "speaker": "bot", "text": "Hello सुनील आपको old and used forklift की requirement है ना?"},
    {"i": 1, "speaker": "caller", "text": "For business use."},
    {"i": 2, "speaker": "caller", "text": "Can you speak in English madam?"},
    {"i": 3, "speaker": "bot", "text": "Sure, I can speak in English."},
    {"i": 4, "speaker": "bot", "text": "Just to confirm, you are interested in old and used forklift, right?"},
    {"i": 5, "speaker": "caller", "text": "Yeah of course."},
    {"i": 6, "speaker": "bot", "text": "Okay take your time."},
    {"i": 7, "speaker": "bot", "text": "I'm here whenever you are ready."},
    {"i": 8, "speaker": "caller", "text": "What is the cost of this vehicle madam?"},
    {"i": 9, "speaker": "bot", "text": "You can discuss the price directly with the seller."},
    {"i": 10, "speaker": "bot", "text": "I will connect you with the best sellers."},
    {"i": 11, "speaker": "bot", "text": "Just need to confirm a few more details first."},
    {"i": 12, "speaker": "caller", "text": "Okay."},
    {"i": 13, "speaker": "bot", "text": "Great."},
    {"i": 14, "speaker": "bot", "text": "Could you please tell me which capacity you prefer, 210 or something else?"},
    {"i": 15, "speaker": "caller", "text": "Actually I have seen your ad is piece and used for lift 2 ton side loaded 150000 price."},
    {"i": 16, "speaker": "bot", "text": "Thank you for sharing."},
    {"i": 17, "speaker": "bot", "text": "Just to confirm, do you need a 210 capacity or a different one?"},
    {"i": 18, "speaker": "bot", "text": "Please specify your preference."},
    {"i": 19, "speaker": "caller", "text": "No no no that's enough two ton is enough and I am ready to this price."},
    {"i": 20, "speaker": "bot", "text": "Perfect."},
    {"i": 21, "speaker": "bot", "text": "And which fuel type do you prefer diesel, electric or LPG?"},
    {"i": 22, "speaker": "caller", "text": "Diesel diesel madam."},
    {"i": 23, "speaker": "bot", "text": "Noted."},
    {"i": 24, "speaker": "bot", "text": "I will send you seller details on WhatsApp so you can discuss all details and price directly."},
    {"i": 25, "speaker": "bot", "text": "Thank you for choosing IndiaMART."},
    {"i": 26, "speaker": "bot", "text": "Have a great day."},
    {"i": 27, "speaker": "caller", "text": "Thank you."}
  ]
}
